rooms.name: Treasury
rooms.desc: Gold piles up here. Each tile holds 250 gold.

rooms.name: Lair
rooms.desc: Cosy blanket heaps. Creatures sleep here, and more of them turn up.

rooms.name: Hatchery
rooms.desc: Mushrooms and snacks. Keeps hungry creatures fed.

rooms.name: Training Room
rooms.desc: Creatures practise here, spending gold to gain levels.

rooms.name: Medical Room
rooms.desc: A cosy cot with a red cross. Hurt creatures come here to patch themselves up, much faster than sleeping it off.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.desc: Dusty books that slowly unlock new spells and traps.

rooms.name: Workshop
rooms.desc: Needed before you can build traps and doors.

research.name: Sturdy Doors
research.desc: Doors your creatures stroll through, but tidy knights must knock down.

research.name: Zap Spell
research.desc: Calls down a fizzy cartoon lightning bolt.

research.name: Dart Trap
research.desc: A trap that pings intruders from a distance.
